authority: NONE — DERIVED TRUTH. Measurement only; this file certifies nothing and creates no authority.
question: Why is unconditional certification prohibited, which authority introduced it, and is the limitation fundamental?
classification: Intentional Constitutional Law (not an implementation, governance, architectural or measurement defect, and not an artificial constraint)
why_prohibited: Tier T1 (Constitutional Authority) is VACANT (VAC-01). CMG-000001 X.12 (CMG-L-12) caps standing at PROVISIONAL wherever no located authority confers it. CEP-006 XII.2 permits FINALIZED from a PROVISIONAL determination ONLY upon the act of the out-of-corpus finality authority.

introducing_authorities.text: Program Authority SHALL NOT extend to the substance of the UCOS Ω∞ Constitution. The Program governs how constitutional content is engineered; it does not decide what that content is.
Program Authority SHALL NEVER self-elevate. … no CEP agent SHALL grant itself ratification authority.
Where final constitutional finality requires an authority residing outside the corpus, this Charter SHALL recognize that authority as superior for the purpose of finality…

Where final constitutional finality requires an authority residing outside the corpus, that out-of-corpus authority SHALL be recognized as superior for finality, and Ratification Authority within the corpus SHALL confer only PROVISIONAL acceptance pending that finality.
Ratification Authority SHALL NEVER be self-conferred by Execution Authority.
An ACCEPTED determination MAY reach FINALIZED upon in-corpus finality authority; a PROVISIONAL determination SHALL reach FINALIZED only upon the act of the out-of-corpus finality authority.

Where the finality authority is out-of-corpus or unavailable, the artifact SHALL rest at PROVISIONAL, which is non-blocking to engineering progression and blocking only to declared constitutional finality.
An artifact SHALL NOT declare a standing higher than the standing conferred by a located authority. Where no such authority exists, the standing IS PROVISIONAL.
Certification SHALL NOT be self-issued. The certifying authority SHALL be distinct from the certified subject's author.

limitation_nature.note: Fundamental AS TO EXECUTION AUTHORITY. The cap is a consequence of VAC-01, and VAC-01 has a declared closure procedure — but no in-corpus act may execute it (CEP-000 §5.4; DR-RAT-11 Q7).

conflation_finding: NOT conflated. 09-DR-RAT-11-ASSESSMENT.md §2 poses and answers this question directly: finality is a distinct, higher power from implementation, and 'the corpus cannot self-mint constituent authority (CEP-000 §5.3) — a system cannot be the sole author of its own founding legitimacy.' In-corpus independence is insufficient BECAUSE any in-corpus authority is authored by the corpus. This is CMG LI.6 applied one tier higher: repairing the ceiling in-corpus would re-introduce, at the constituent level, precisely the self-issued-certification defect removed at the certification level under P0-ULTIMATE-CLOSURE-001.

executable_evidence.uccep_finding: UCCEP-F-004 (STANDING-CONSTITUTIONAL-CEILING, blocking, disposition REGISTERED, deliberately retained)
